name: pacto-squad-sponsor
description: Collective squad-scoped gas sponsorship for Pacto
author: Pacto

scripts.commit: pnpm lint:fix && pnpm lint:natspec && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration
scripts.cutover:paymaster:sepolia: bash -c 'source .env && forge script CutoverPaymasterOps --rpc-url sepolia --account $SEPOLIA_DEPLOYER_NAME --broadcast --chain sepolia -vvvvv && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=verify forge script VerifyDeploy --rpc-url sepolia --chain sepolia -vvvv'
